title: A Weighted Turan Unit-Step Inequality for Modified Bessel Functions and Its Determinant Corollary
abstract: For x>0 and real m>=1 we prove the strict weighted unit-step inequality phi_m(x)<phi_(m+1)(x), where phi_m=[(m-1)I_(m-1)^2+(m+1)I_(m+1)^2]/(m I_m^2). The proof eliminates adjacent ratios by their classical recurrences and uses an exact factorization calibrated to an Amos upper bound. For explicitly defined coefficient arrays this gives strict ordering of their two-by-two determinants. A factorial majorant proves absolute convergence, uniform in the real angle for each fixed positive coupling, of a related signed application series; its sign remains open. This corrected version fixes attribution, removes unsupported numerical precision and proof-method assertions, and supplies immutable source provenance. The included earlier ordered-field Lean formalization carries analytic recurrences and the Amos bound as named hypotheses; its log is historical and has not been replayed for this revision. No fresh symbolic or numerical audit, physical positivity result, continuum limit or Yang-Mills mass gap is claimed. Classical inputs are credited and historical priority of the particular weighted statement is not established by an exhaustive comparison.
